description: Subscribe to a domain: a signed JSON POST goes to your webhook when its llms.txt changes, breaks, is restored, loses its llms-full.txt, changes tier, or its verification changes. Returns a watch id and a secret (shown once) for the signature and for unsubscribing. 20 new watches per hour per client, 5 active per domain per client.

domain.description: A domain name such as example.com (no scheme, no path).

webhook_url.description: Public http(s) URL that accepts a JSON POST.

name: watch_domain
title: Watch domain
